description: Dataset of "Detecting Weaknesses and Analyzing Cascading Failures in Critical Infrastructure Networks Using an Interconnected Simulation System is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Petr Mlýnek, Radek Fujdiak (Brno University of Technology). This article introduces a simulator for critical infrastructure, developed to enable comprehensivesimulation of data and power grid and their interconnections. The simulator offers user-input functionality,allowing for detailed modelling and analysis of various impact scenarios on infrastructures. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
